description: This file defines a React component for a Preferences Page in a web application, allowing users to customize content preferences, notification settings, and music provider options with persistence via a store. It includes UI components for toggles, buttons, and cards, and manages local draft state before saving to persistent storage.

methods.name: PreferencesPage
methods.description: React functional component that renders the preferences form with controls for music provider, traffic insights, content types, and notifications. Manages local draft state, updates preferences, handles reset and save operations.
